(2) There shall be paid out of the fund, all sums of moneys
required to defray any expenditure incurred by the institution
in  the  exercise,  performance  and  discharge  of  its  powers,
duties and function under this Act.

10.
The institution shall be able and capable in law to
acquire and hold any property, movable or immovable which
may become vested in it by virtue of any purchase, grant,
lease, gift, testamentary disposition or otherwise and all such
property shall be held by the institution and all such property
shall be held by the corporation for the purposes of this Act
and  subject  to  the  rules  of  the  Corporation  made  under
Section 7.

11.
If  upon  the  dissolution  of  the  institution  there
remains after the satisfaction of all its debts and liabilities
any  property  whatsoever,  such  property  shall  not  be
distributed among the members of the institution, but shall
be given or transferred to any other institution or institutions
having objects similar to those of the institution and which,
is or are by its or their rules prohibited from distributing any
income or property among their members.

12.
(1) The Council of the Institute shall cause proper
accounts to be kept of all moneys received and expended by
the  institution.
(2)  The  financial  year  of  the  institution  shall  be  the
calendar year.
(3) The accounts of the institution shall be examined and
audited at least once in every year by an auditor or auditors
appointed by the Board of Council.
